whatsNew:
Projects in every chat

Keep a chat's summaries, files and links together. Open a chat, tap the folder at the top, and make a project (on a computer, right-click "Projects" under the open chat). Everyone in the chat sees its projects. Each one has three drawers: Summaries, Uploads and Links.

While a project is selected, "Saving to …" shows above the message box, and the files, photos, links and summaries you send are saved into it by themselves. A saved summary is named by the AI and always shows the date it was made; you can rename it, and the date stays. Anything in a drawer can be downloaded or opened again.

Find by keyword

The new Find chip next to All shows which chats a word or a project name came up in, and opens the chat right at that message.

Summaries wait for enough to say

A summary needs a few messages with some substance; until then the sheet says so.

Copying pictures

In the browser, copying a photo now works everywhere: from the message menu, the Copy button in the full-screen view, Ctrl/Cmd+C there, and the browser's own right-click menu. Photo-heavy chats also no longer block the next file you send.

Please check

- Make a project in a group, send a link and a file, and open the project's drawers.
- Ask for a summary while the project is selected, then download it as PDF.
- Use Find with a word from an older message.
